match_prefix_MambaRadixCache: match a token sequence prefix against the radix tree and return matching indices and last node
insert_MambaRadixCache: insert a new sequence with key, value, and mamba value into the radix tree for hybrid KV cache
evict_MambaRadixCache: evict least recently used nodes from full KV cache or mamba cache to free memory
cache_finished_req_MambaRadixCache: cache a finished request's KV indices and mamba state into the radix tree
sanity_check_MambaRadixCache: run a sanity check on the radix tree LRU lists to verify eviction state consistency
